GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2016-12-10T10:36:12Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Is it safe to access private members by using an element access expression?
Description: **TypeScript Version:**  2.1 / nightly (2.2.0-dev.20161127)

**Code**
```ts
interface SomeType { }

class A { private m: SomeType; }

class B {
	foo(a: A) {
		const n1 = a.m; // (1)
		const n2 = a["m"]; // (2)
	}
}
```
As expected, the property access expression (1) produces a compile error. However, the element access expression (2) does not, even though typescript recognizes that (2) refers to member "A.m" as it infers the type "SomeType" for n2.

Can I expect (2) to not produce any compile errors in future typescript versions?
